name: The Heaven Game: Empty Skull Gaiden
source:
Explore the early days of SKULL, renowned angelic duelist, and her complicated relationship with her childhood friend CROSS. Watch as both discover and become embroiled in the enigmatic game taking the world by storm.

[Edited from [url=https://roseofrevolt.itch.io/the-heaven-game-empty-skull-gaiden]itch.io[/url]]
